page: Vultr voc-c-2c-4gb-75s-amd is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Optimized Cloud Compute family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at 2.0 GHz, consisting of 1 physical core and 2 threads. The hardware configuration includes 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and 75 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include a GPU.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core scoring 2929.97 and Geekbench single-core reaching 2145.0, both placing in the top 25%. Text processing is also a strength, scoring 2610.0 in Geekbench. However, multi-core performance is weak, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 3854.0 and a stress-ng multi-core score of 5812.19. Memory bandwidth is generally limited, with read-only small block bandwidth at 267.12 GB/sec and large block at 38.07 GB/sec, though write bandwidth for large blocks is average at 34.24 GB/sec.

The server exhibits poor performance in database operations, with a PassMark database score of 935.72, and static web serving throughput of 2.39 GB/sec, both landing in the bottom 10%. It is also weak in software compilation and image processing. Given these performance characteristics, the server is best suited for lightweight, single-threaded tasks, basic text processing, or small-scale applications that do not require high memory bandwidth or intensive multi-core parallelization.
